selfSendBody: This sends {{symbol}} from this account back to the same address. Nothing arrives anywhere new, and you still pay the network fee.
selfSendConfirm: I understand, send to my own address anyway
ownWalletNote: This address belongs to your wallet. You are moving funds between your own accounts.
customFeeHint: Set a low fee and the transaction may take a long time or get stuck.
invalidGasPrice: Enter a gas price in gwei greater than 0
invalidGasLimit: Gas limit must be a whole number of at least 21000
invalidSatPerVByte: Enter a fee rate in sat/vByte greater than 0
switchInput: Switch between crypto and USD input
invalidBtcAddress: Invalid Bitcoin address — must start with 1, 3, or bc1
invalidLtcAddress: Invalid Litecoin address — must start with L, M, 3, or ltc1
invalidDogeAddress: Invalid Dogecoin address — must start with D
invalidDashAddress: Invalid Dash address — must start with X
invalidZecAddress: Invalid Zcash transparent address — must start with t1 or t3. For shielded (u1/zs1), use the Privacy tab.
invalidEvmAddress: Invalid address — must be 0x followed by 40 hex characters
ensNotSupported: ENS names aren't supported yet — paste the 0x address
burnAddress: This is a burn address — anything sent here is lost forever
contactIsOwnAddress: This is one of your own wallet addresses — it's already in your address book
invalidEvmChecksum: Checksum mismatch — this address may contain a typo. Copy it again from the source
invalidChecksum: This address has a typo: its checksum doesn't match. Copy it again from the source.
signingInvalidAddress: Your KeepKey rejected the recipient address. Check the address and try again.
invalidCosmosPrefix: Wrong address prefix for this network
invalidXrpAddress: Invalid XRP address — must start with r
invalidSolanaAddress: Invalid Solana address — must be 32-44 base58 characters
invalidTronAddress: Invalid Tron address — must start with T (34 characters)
invalidZcashShieldedAddress: Invalid Zcash address — must start with u1 (unified), zs1 (Sapling), t1, or t3
invalidAmount: Enter an ungrouped decimal amount, for example 1.5. Thousands separators are not accepted.
switchAmountUnit: Tap to switch between USD and native amount
feeOverQuarter: Fee is more than 25% of the amount you are sending. Check the gas price.
recipientIsSentToken: This is the {{symbol}} token contract itself, not a wallet. Tokens sent to it are lost. Paste the recipient's wallet address.
recipientBurnBody: No one holds the key to this address. Anything sent here is destroyed and can never be recovered.
recipientTokenContractBody: A token contract is not a wallet. Funds sent here are almost always lost.
recipientTokenContractConfirm: I understand, send to the contract anyway
recipientContractNote: This address is a smart contract. Make sure it can receive {{symbol}}: funds sent to a contract that cannot handle them may be lost.
customGasPriceTooHigh: Gas price is 10x or more the network price ({{gwei}} gwei). Lower it or use a preset.
customGasPriceTooLow: Gas price is below the network base fee (~{{gwei}} gwei). The transaction would never confirm.
customGasPriceUnavailable: The network gas price could not be loaded, so a custom gas price cannot be checked. Try again, or use a preset.
